sentences.en: Oslo Airport has fifty escalators, six moving lanes and eighty-seven elevators.
sentences.zh: 奥斯陆机场有五十部自动扶梯、六条行进通道和八十七部电梯。

sentences.en: Do not lean against nonmoving parts of the escalator.
sentences.zh: 不要倚靠自动扶梯的非运行部分。

sentences.en: The sign indicates the location of the escalator.
sentences.zh: 指示牌标明了自动扶梯的位置。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：escal（梯子）+ator（表名词，器物）→电动扶梯
